integrity: The degree barrier follows from a two-regular neighborhood-link lemma. The spherical and toroidal transition examples are given with explicit edge descriptions, symbolic proofs, and a standard-library exhaustive small-witness checker. Relevant primary axiom statements and the earlier planar obstruction were examined in full-text HTML. The originality assessment includes a weaker prior genus bound and retains residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: The bound for higher axiom depths is necessary, not a sharp genus determination. No minimum toroidal order is asserted. Finite experiments verify only the two explicit witnesses, while the universal assertion has a mathematical proof. Exact historical priority and independent mathematical audit are unperformed.
title: Sharp sphere–torus obstructions for finite Farey-type graphs
